title: Party backdrop: the 16px blur is back
why: The 8px blur let the labels of the hub show through the party pages as ghost words and the critic scored the board 2 of 5 again. The 16px blur is back, with a scrim that keeps a little more of the glow.
now: The party pages have a soft backdrop with no ghost words.

edits.anchor: body #attract{ -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(var(--sp-1)); backdrop-filter:blur(var(--sp-1)); background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 42%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-raised) 18%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-bg) 62%, transparent) 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-void) 84%, transparent) 100%); }
edits.replacement: body #attract{ -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(var(--sp-2)); backdrop-filter:blur(var(--sp-2)); background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 42%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-raised) 30%, transparent) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-bg) 76%, transparent) 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ui-void) 90%, transparent) 100%); }   /* v30.xx (cw-partyglow2): 16px again, the 8px blur showed the hub labels (critic 56 = 2) */
